Hi Eliot — thanks again for a helpful discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- What we heard: primary use-case is high-throughput document classification + PII redaction at inference; latency targets ~200ms p95 for short payloads; strict audit/logging requirements.
- Risk & blockers: procurement wants standard terms + SSO; Security needs SOC2/Audit artifacts and a short architecture review.

Proposed next steps: 
1) 60-minute technical deep dive (monica to lead) to go through ingestion, SSO options, and perf expectations.
2) Security intake call (30 mins) with our security engineer to review SOC2 and logging.
3) Procurement checklist and commercial path — looping Sara from your side.

Availability: Monica and I are available next week (PDT) on Tues 8/10 09:00–11:00 or Wed 8/11 14:00–16:00. If those don't work, share a couple of windows that do and we will prioritize.

I've attached a short one-pager recap from today and a proposed technical topics deck for the deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the next meetings on calendar.

—Naomi
